name: feat-2890-3d
title: #2890 round 2 — 3-D computes off the page: the page stays alive, the figure comes first and the data panel's values follow (PR, port 5188)

cases.title: 3-D: while a slow line computes the figure can be turned; the figure comes first, then the panel says «בודק…», then its rows
cases.lookFor: Type the first two lines. Type the third and press Enter. While «הוסף» reads «חושב…», drag the figure with the mouse: it turns, and the page scrolls. When the prism lands, the data panel on the left reads one grey line «בודק…» for a few seconds, and then all its rows appear together (the parameter k, the points, the planes).
cases.before: On prod the page freezes for the whole line: the drag does nothing until the figure lands, and the figure and the panel appear together.

cases.title: 3-D: after «הציגו תצורה אחרת» on a figure whose values take seconds, the panel reads «בודק…» and no number of the previous drawing
cases.lookFor: Right after the press the new drawing is on the canvas and the panel shows only «בודק…»; its rows come back a few seconds later.
cases.before: On prod the page freezes for the press, then the new drawing and its panel appear together.

cases.title: 3-D: a row unticked redraws the figure at once; the panel reads «בודק…» until its values are in
cases.lookFor: Untick row 1: the figure is redrawn at once, the panel reads «בודק…», then its rows.
cases.before: On prod the page freezes, then the figure and its panel appear together.

cases.title: 3-D: a fast figure is drawn whole: the panel never reads «בודק…»
cases.lookFor: The cube and M on BB′; the panel's rows are there with the figure every time.

cases.title: 3-D: a wrong claim is still refused
cases.lookFor: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב»; one row.

cases.title: 3-D: the slow square figure, a row off and on, and «הציגו תצורה אחרת»
cases.lookFor: Three rows at the end, S with SA = 5; the press redraws; the panel's «|AS| = 5» row is back.

cases.title: 3-D: a question in the panel is answered (solved off the page)
cases.lookFor: The question row reads «|AC| = 5.66», as on prod.

cases.title: 3-D: «בטל» and «בצע שוב» bring the rows back
cases.lookFor: Three rows at the end, D on AB.
